text:
olivia: Quick check — we want to enable the 'sticky_affinity' feature for multi-region failover tomorrow AM for a small canary. Plan: route failed EU sessions to NA, but keep session stickiness by session_id. Anyone object?

kevin: Question — what are the guardrails? latency SLO, rollback thresholds, and percentage for the canary?

marta: PR is up for the toggle and API change: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/+/I-7682 — needs 1 reviewer + sig from oncall.

chris: Heads-up: sticky by session_id means cookie TTL/regen matters. We should limit to new sessions only to avoid reassigning long-lived sessions mid-flight.

olivia: Agreed. Canary audience: 5% new sessions originating in EU (explicit region filter). Duration 2 hours. Rollback triggers: >0.5% error spike OR p95 latency increase >150ms over baseline.

kevin: I'll wire alerts. Metrics to capture: reroute.count, reroute.latency.p50/p95, model.fallback.rate, session.affinity.hit_rate.

kevin: Adding dashboard and alert links: https://dashboards.redwood/internal/d/ff-fallback/affinity-canary (will set thresholds).

devops-bot: playbook created: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/affinity-failover-canary — toggle will be staged via feature-flags service, operator approval required.

olivia: Config snippet for the flag (will deploy to flags-test then prod):

```
feature_flag: sticky_affinity_multi_region
enabled: false
canary: { region: "eu", new_sessions_only: true, pct: 5, duration_minutes: 120 }
guardrails: { max_error_rate_pct: 0.5, max_p95_latency_ms: 150 }
behavior: { fallback_region: "na", model_variant: "v1.2-fallback" }
```

marta: Code change notes: runtime will respect kv-cache TTL so session_id affinity won't break KV caching. PR includes unit tests + e2e harness. Please review lines 120-165 in the PR.

chris: One more: ensure we tag affected requests with `x-affinity-triggered: true` so we can query logs easily.

kevin: I'll add that to the logs/metrics pipeline. I'll also add a short-lived trace sampling at 20% for the canary to inspect KV cache behavior.

oncall-jordan: Please ping me once you flip the flag. I'll standby and run the runbook if we hit rollback thresholds. (add: escalate to SRE pager if >1% sustained error for 15m).

olivia: Checklist before flip:
- [ ] PR merged and deploy green
- [ ] Flags staged to flags-test
- [ ] Dashboards/alerts ready (kevin)
- [ ] Runbook linked (devops-bot)
- [ ] Oncall notified (jordan)

olivia: If no objections, i'll request operator approval at 11:55 UTC and schedule the 12:00 UTC canary. Please react with :thumbsup: to approve or :eyes: for questions.

marta: :thumbsup:

kevin: :thumbsup: I'll post the dashboard summary 15m after flip.

chris: :eyes: reviewing PR now, will comment inline if anything pops up.

oncall-jordan: :thumbsup: I'll be on watch.

devops-bot: operator approval pending — approver: @platform-ops

olivia: Thanks all — will update this thread when we start the canary.
